events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (/app/index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

input.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #060404; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; touch-action: none; cursor: default; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen in warm, dim light"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var cv = document.getElementById('c'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  var W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1, S = 1, OX = 0, OY = 0;
  var PI = Math.PI, TAU = PI * 2;

  // geometry (scene units)
  var RX = 300, RY = 105;            // rim
  var IRX = 289, IRY = 99;           // inner rim
  var BRX = 272, BRY = 95, BY = 22;  // broth surface
  var K = BRY / BRX;

  function mulberry(a) { return function () { a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0; var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a); t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t; return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; }
  var rnd = mulberry(20261110);
  function rr(a, b) { return a + (b - a) * rnd(); }

  var mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var reduced = mq.matches;

  // pointer state
  var tx = 0, ty = -0.2, lx = 0, ly = -0.2;      // light target / smoothed (-1..1)
  var msx = 1e5, msy = 1e5, mvx = 0, mvy = 0;     // pointer in scene units + velocity
  var lastRip = 0, pending = false;
  var T = 0, last = 0;

  // ---------- precomputed content ----------
  var sprite = document.createElement('canvas'); sprite.width = sprite.height = 128;
  (function () {
    var g = sprite.getContext('2d'), gr = g.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 0, 64, 64, 64);
    gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,240,224,1)'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(255,236,218,0.55)');
    gr.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(250,232,216,0.14)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(250,232,216,0)');
    g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
  })();

  var speckles = []; for (var i = 0; i < 170; i++) speckles.push([rr(-300, 300), rr(0, 215), rr(0.5, 1.6), rr(0.04, 0.16)]);
  var oil = []; for (i = 0; i < 46; i++) oil.push({ r: Math.sqrt(rr(0.05, 0.95)), a: rr(0, TAU), s: rr(2.5, 9), w: rr(0.012, 0.04), p: rr(0, TAU) });
  var noodles = []; for (i = 0; i < 30; i++) noodles.push({ cu: -0.04 + rr(-0.1, 0.1), cv: 0.08 + rr(-0.1, 0.1), R: rr(0.16, 0.5), a0: rr(0, TAU), sw: rr(2.4, 5.2) * (rnd() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1), ph: rr(0, TAU) });
  var motes = []; for (i = 0; i < 34; i++) motes.push({ x: rr(-1, 1), y: rr(-1, 1), z: rr(0.3, 1), p: rr(0, TAU), s: rr(1.5, 5) });
  var sesame = []; for (i = 0; i < 46; i++) { var sa = rr(0, TAU), sr = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.5; sesame.push([-0.04 + Math.cos(sa) * sr, 0.08 + Math.sin(sa) * sr, rr(0, PI), rnd() < 0.25]); }
  var ripples = [], steam = [];

  // toppings
  var tops = [];
  function add(type, u, v, o) { o = o || {}; o.type = type; o.u = u; o.v = v; o.ph = rr(0, TAU); tops.push(o); }
  add('nori', -0.48, -0.6);
  add('bok', 0.5, -0.42);
  add('radish', -0.02, -0.62, { r: 34 }); add('radish', 0.14, -0.55, { r: 36 }); add('radish', -0.17, -0.5, { r: 33 });
  add('tofu', 0.62, 0.02, { rot: 0.5 }); add('tofu', 0.42, 0.34, { rot: 1.1 }); add('tofu', 0.68, 0.36, { rot: 0.15 });
  add('shroom', -0.66, 0.02, { r: 44, rot: 0.3 }); add('shroom', -0.5, 0.4, { r: 40, rot: 1.2 }); add('shroom', -0.76, 0.34, { r: 34, rot: 2.0 });
  for (i = 0; i < 13; i++) { var ca = rr(0, TAU), cr = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.17; add('corn', 0.02 + Math.cos(ca) * cr, 0.66 + Math.sin(ca) * cr * 0.8, { rot: rr(0, PI) }); }
  for (i = 0; i < 17; i++) { var ga = rr(0, TAU), gr0 = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.4; add('scallion', -0.04 + Math.cos(ga) * gr0, 0.1 + Math.sin(ga) * gr0, { r: rr(6, 9.5), tilt: rr(-0.5, 0.5) }); }
  for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) { var ha = rr(0, TAU), hr = rr(0.05, 0.36); add('chili', -0.04 + Math.cos(ha) * hr, 0.1 + Math.sin(ha) * hr, { r: rr(5.5, 8) }); }
  tops.sort(function (a, b) { return a.v - b.v; });

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function rippleAt(u, v) { // vertical displacement at broth-plane point
    var d = 0, x = u * BRX, y = v * BRX;
    for (var i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) {
      var r = ripples[i], dx = x - r.x, dy = y - r.y, dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      var q = (dist - r.age * 130) / 26, life = 1 - r.age / r.max;
      d += Math.sin(q * 2.2) * Math.exp(-q * q) * r.amp * life * 3.2;
    }
    return d;
  }
  function bob(o) { return Math.sin(T * 1.25 + o.ph) * 1.1 + rippleAt(o.u, o.v); }
  function ell(x, y, rx, ry, rot) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, rot || 0, 0, TAU); }
  function addRipple(u, v, amp) { if (ripples.length < 26) ripples.push({ x: u * BRX, y: v * BRX, age: 0, max: 2.3, amp: amp }); }

  function spawn(p, x, y) {
    var a = Math.random() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * 0.78;
    p.x = x !== undefined ? x : Math.cos(a) * r * BRX;
    p.y = y !== undefined ? y : BY + Math.sin(a) * r * BRY - 8;
    p.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10; p.vy = -(26 + Math.random() * 34);
    p.life = 0; p.max = 4 + Math.random() * 4.5; p.size = 34 + Math.random() * 44; p.seed = Math.random() * 100;
    return p;
  }
  function stepSteam(dt) {
    for (var i = 0; i < steam.length; i++) {
      var p = steam[i]; p.life += dt;
      if (p.life >= p.max) { spawn(p); continue; }
      p.vx += (Math.sin(p.y * 0.011 + T * 0.7 + p.seed) * 22 - p.x * 0.12 - p.vx * 1.1) * dt;
      p.vy += (-34 - p.vy) * 0.25 * dt;
      var dx = p.x - msx, dy = p.y - msy, d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 0.01;
      if (d < 170) {
        var f = 1 - d / 170;
        p.vx += ((mvx * 0.5 - p.vx) * 3 + dx / d * 150) * f * dt;
        p.vy += ((mvy * 0.5 - p.vy) * 3 + dy / d * 110) * f * dt;
      }
      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
    }
  }
  for (i = 0; i < 120; i++) { var sp = spawn({}); steam.push(sp); }
  (function () { for (var k = 0; k < 500; k++) { T += 1 / 60; stepSteam(1 / 60); } })();

  // ---------- drawing ----------
  function drawBackground(flick) {
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#060404'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    var gx = OX + lx * 60 * S, gy = OY - 170 * S + ly * 30 * S;
    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, gy, 0, gx, gy, 760 * S);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,138,58,' + (0.2 * flick) + ')'); g.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(190,70,30,' + (0.09 * flick) + ')'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // table
    var ty0 = OY + 95 * S;
    g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, ty0, 0, Math.max(H, ty0 + 1));
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(34,18,11,0)'); g.addColorStop(0.18, 'rgba(34,18,11,0.9)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(8,5,4,1)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, ty0, W, H - ty0);
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(OX + lx * 20 * S, OY + 235 * S); ctx.scale(1, 0.26);
    g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 720 * S);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,150,70,' + (0.26 * flick) + ')'); g.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(160,70,30,' + (0.1 * flick) + ')'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 720 * S, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
    // dust motes
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
    for (var i = 0; i < motes.length; i++) {
      var m = motes[i];
      var x = OX + (m.x * 620 + Math.sin(T * 0.13 * m.z + m.p) * 40 - lx * 26 * m.z) * S;
      var y = OY - 120 * S + ((((m.y * 420 - T * 6 * m.z) % 840) - 840) % 840 + 420) * S - ly * 12 * m.z * S;
      var s = m.s * m.z * S * 2.2;
      ctx.globalAlpha = (0.1 + 0.1 * Math.sin(T * 0.9 + m.p * 3)) * m.z * flick;
      ctx.drawImage(sprite, x - s, y - s, s * 2, s * 2);
      ctx.globalAlpha *= 0.35; ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9a50'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, s * 1.1, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  }

  function bodyPath() {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-RX, 0);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-292, 128, -172, 204, -96, 212);
    ctx.lineTo(96, 212);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(172, 204, 292, 128, RX, 0);
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, RX, RY, 0, 0, PI, true); ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawChopsticks(flick) {
    for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      var x0 = -345 + i * 14, y0 = 296 + i * 15, x1 = 330 + i * 10, y1 = 268 + i * 6;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 9; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0 + 4, y0 + 6); ctx.lineTo(x1 + 4, y1 + 7); ctx.stroke();
      var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, 0, x1, 0);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#2a1710'); g.addColorStop(0.45 + lx * 0.2, '#6a3a22'); g.addColorStop(1, '#1d100b');
      ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x0, y0 - 2.2); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1 - 5); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1 + 5); ctx.lineTo(x0, y0 + 2.2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,170,100,' + (0.3 * flick) + ')'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0 - 1.6); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1 - 3.8); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  function drawBowl(flick) {
    var g;
    // contact shadow
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(-lx * 26, 226); ctx.scale(1, 0.17);
    g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 60, 0, 0, 400);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.92)'); g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 400, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
    // foot
    g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-100, 0, 100, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0b0807'); g.addColorStop(0.5 + lx * 0.25, '#3b2a22'); g.addColorStop(1, '#090606');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-98, 206); ctx.lineTo(-90, 228); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 240, 90, 228); ctx.lineTo(98, 206); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    // body
    var lp = Math.min(0.85, Math.max(0.15, 0.5 + lx * 0.3));
    g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-RX, 0, RX, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0d0a0a'); g.addColorStop(Math.max(0.02, lp - 0.28), '#1c1719'); g.addColorStop(lp, '#3a3033'); g.addColorStop(Math.min(0.98, lp + 0.3), '#191416'); g.addColorStop(1, '#070505');
    bodyPath(); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
    ctx.save(); bodyPath(); ctx.clip();
    g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 60, 0, 220);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60,24,8,' + (0.55 * flick) + ')');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-RX, 0, RX * 2, 240);
    for (var i = 0; i < speckles.length; i++) { var s = speckles[i]; ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(235,205,175,' + s[3] + ')'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s[0], s[1], s[2], 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
    // glaze highlight
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(lx * 150 - 20, 118 + ly * 14); ctx.rotate(-lx * 0.25); ctx.scale(0.42, 1);
    g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 120);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,205,160,' + (0.34 * flick) + ')'); g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,150,90,' + (0.1 * flick) + ')'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,150,90,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 120, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
    // warm rim spill under lip
    g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 90, 0, 150); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,140,60,' + (0.14 * flick) + ')'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,140,60,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-RX, 0, RX * 2, 160);
    ctx.restore();
    // inner wall
    g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -IRY, 0, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#171011'); g.addColorStop(0.5, '#3a2014'); g.addColorStop(1, '#6e3a16');
    ell(0, 0, IRX, IRY); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
  }

  function rimRing(front, flick) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); if (front) ctx.rect(-RX - 10, 0, RX * 2 + 20, RY + 20); else ctx.rect(-RX - 10, -RY - 20, RX * 2 + 20, RY + 20); ctx.clip();
    var lp = Math.min(0.85, Math.max(0.15, 0.5 + lx * 0.3));
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-RX, 0, RX, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#1b1211'); g.addColorStop(lp, front ? '#8a6450' : '#5a4036'); g.addColorStop(1, '#140d0c');
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, RX, RY, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, IRX, IRY, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill('evenodd');
    g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-RX, 0, RX, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,200,160,0)'); g.addColorStop(lp, 'rgba(255,215,180,' + (0.75 * flick) + ')'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,200,160,0)');
    ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ell(0, 0, RX - 3.5, RY - 2.2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function brothClip() {
    ell(0, 0, IRX, IRY); ctx.clip(); ell(0, BY, BRX, BRY); ctx.clip();
  }

  function drawBroth(flick) {
    ctx.save(); brothClip();
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(0, BY); ctx.scale(1, K);
    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx * 70 - 20, ly * 40, 10, 0, 0, BRX);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#f4bf68'); g.addColorStop(0.45, '#e09a40'); g.addColorStop(0.8, '#bf6a22'); g.addColorStop(1, '#8a4212');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-BRX, -BRX, BRX * 2, BRX * 2);
    // slow swirling sheen
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'soft-light';
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      var a = T * (0.05 + i * 0.012) + i * 1.9, r = BRX * (0.35 + 0.12 * i);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,240,200,' + (0.22 - i * 0.025) + ')'; ctx.lineWidth = 16 + i * 5; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(Math.sin(T * 0.11 + i) * 14, Math.cos(T * 0.09 + i * 2) * 14, r, a, a + 1.3 + 0.5 * Math.sin(T * 0.2 + i)); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.restore();

    // chili oil droplets
    for (i = 0; i < oil.length; i++) {
      var o = oil[i], aa = o.a + T * o.w + Math.sin(T * 0.3 + o.p) * 0.05, rr0 = o.r + Math.sin(T * 0.21 + o.p) * 0.012;
      var u = Math.cos(aa) * rr0, v = Math.sin(aa) * rr0, x = u * BRX, y = BY + v * BRY + rippleAt(u, v) * 0.6;
      ell(x, y, o.s, o.s * 0.42); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(206,52,16,0.62)'; ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,150,60,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.9; ctx.stroke();
      ell(x - o.s * 0.3 + lx * o.s * 0.3, y - o.s * 0.14, o.s * 0.26, o.s * 0.1); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,225,180,' + (0.7 * flick) + ')'; ctx.fill();
    }

    // noodles
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    for (i = 0; i < noodles.length; i++) {
      var n = noodles[i], pts = [];
      for (var j = 0; j < 26; j++) {
        var ang = n.a0 + n.sw * j / 25;
        var rad = n.R * (1 + 0.2 * Math.sin(ang * 3 + n.ph) + 0.035 * Math.sin(T * 0.8 + n.ph + j * 0.45));
        var nu = n.cu + rad * Math.cos(ang), nv = n.cv + rad * Math.sin(ang);
        var lift = Math.max(0, 1 - rad / 0.5) * 12 + i * 0.12;
        pts.push(nu * BRX, BY + nv * BRY - lift + rippleAt(nu, nv) * 0.7);
      }
      for (var pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        var off = pass === 2 ? -1.6 : 0;
        ctx.moveTo(pts[0], pts[1] + off);
        for (j = 2; j < pts.length - 2; j += 2) ctx.quadraticCurveTo(pts[j], pts[j + 1] + off, (pts[j] + pts[j + 2]) / 2, (pts[j + 1] + pts[j + 3]) / 2 + off);
        ctx.lineTo(pts[pts.length - 2], pts[pts.length - 1] + off);
        if (pass === 0) { ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(128,72,18,0.85)'; ctx.lineWidth = 8.5; }
        else if (pass === 1) { ctx.strokeStyle = i % 3 ? '#efcd82' : '#e7c070'; ctx.lineWidth = 6; }
        else { ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,247,214,' + (0.6 * flick) + ')'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    // submerge the nest edge in broth
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(-0.04 * BRX, BY + 0.08 * BRY); ctx.scale(1, K);
    g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, BRX * 0.33, 0, 0, BRX * 0.62);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(214,138,54,0)'); g.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(210,130,50,0.62)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200,116,42,0.94)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, BRX * 1.4, 0, TAU); ctx.arc(0, 0, BRX * 0.3, 0, TAU, true); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();

    // ripples
    for (i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) {
      var rp = ripples[i], life = 1 - rp.age / rp.max, rad2 = rp.age * 130 + 2;
      var cx = rp.x, cy = BY + rp.y * K;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.4 * life + 0.4;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,238,200,' + (0.5 * life * rp.amp) + ')'; ell(cx, cy, rad2, rad2 * K); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(110,50,10,' + (0.35 * life * rp.amp) + ')'; ell(cx, cy + 2.5, rad2 + 4, (rad2 + 4) * K); ctx.stroke();
      if (rad2 > 30) { ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,238,200,' + (0.25 * life * rp.amp) + ')'; ell(cx, cy, rad2 - 26, (rad2 - 26) * K); ctx.stroke(); }
    }

    // specular + edge shadow
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(lx * 150, BY + ly * 30 - 22); ctx.scale(1, 0.3);
    g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 150);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,244,220,' + (0.34 * flick) + ')'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,244,220,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 150, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
    g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, BY - BRY, 0, BY - BRY + 40);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(50,18,4,0.6)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(50,18,4,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(-BRX, BY - BRY, BRX * 2, 40);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(70,28,6,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 7; ell(0, BY, BRX, BRY); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ----- toppings -----
  function drawNori(o, flick) {
    var by = BY + o.v * BRY, sway = Math.sin(T * 0.6 + o.ph) * 0.012 + rippleAt(o.u, o.v) * 0.004;
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(o.u * BRX, by + 16); ctx.rotate(-0.1 + sway);
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-70, 0, 70, -40);

events.content:
The page is written to `/app/index.html`, but I have not opened it in a browser, so the look and the interactions are untested.

It is a single full-screen canvas drawn entirely in code, with no external assets, raster images or on-page text.

- **Scene:** a dark speckled ceramic bowl on a dim table, lit by a warm glow with a slight candle-like flicker, drifting dust motes, a vignette, and a pair of chopsticks lying faintly in front.
- **Ramen:** a creamy miso-coloured broth with chili-oil droplets and a nest of noodles. Toppings are seared tofu cubes, scored shiitake caps, bok choy, watermelon radish slices, corn, scallion rings, chili slices, sesame seeds and a sheet of nori.
- **Motion:** steam rises and curls continuously, the oil drifts in a slow swirl, the noodles sway, the toppings bob, and small ripples surface now and then.
- **Mouse and touch:**
  - The light and highlights follow the pointer, with a slight parallax shift.
  - Moving across the broth leaves ripples that lift the toppings as they pass.
  - Steam is pushed aside by the cursor.
  - A click or tap makes a stronger ripple and a puff of steam.
- **Responsive:** the scene scales to fit any viewport and redraws on resize, with device pixel ratio capped at 2.
- **Reduced motion:** with `prefers-reduced-motion` set, it shows one still frame with the steam already formed and no animation loop. Only the lighting shifts when the pointer moves, and it switches live if the setting changes.
